content.text: Virtues.id is a human development platform that helps individuals and organizations understand their strengths through Virtues Profiling™, enabling self-awareness, personal growth, and better team performance.
The main goal was to transform a complex and intangible psychological service into a clear, engaging, and conversion-driven digital experience that encourages users to take the profiling test.
The hero section highlights a strong value proposition with a clear primary call-to-action, guiding users directly to the core action while reducing hesitation.
The information architecture follows a structured storytelling approach: explaining the product, its benefits, the target users, and the expected outcomes to build understanding and trust.
A dual-audience strategy was implemented to address both individual users for self-development and corporate users for team and HR solutions without creating confusion.
Friendly illustrations and a clean layout were used to simplify abstract concepts, improve readability, and create a more human and approachable experience.
This project demonstrates how clear content hierarchy, strong CTA strategy, and visual storytelling can increase engagement and conversion for an intangible product.
